reason: A browser-side settings utility that adds per-model image, reasoning, context-window, and output-token configuration, with optional presets from models.dev.

summaries.zh: 在模型设置页面为自定义模型添加图像支持、思考等级、上下文窗口和最大输出 token 配置，并可使用 models.dev 预设。
summaries.en: Adds per-model controls for image support, reasoning levels, context windows, and maximum output tokens in the model settings page, with optional presets from models.dev.

capabilities: Adds model capability controls to the settings interface
Reads model presets from the public models.dev database
Writes per-model image support and reasoning-effort settings
Updates model context-window and maximum-output fields through the host editor
